There is no advertising-context.md anywhere in the repo. Get me set up and tell me what to do first.

Creates or drafts advertising-context.md at the project root with structured one-line fields (business model, offer/price, channels/spend, conversion source of truth, constraints, stakeholders) rather than free-form prose.
Includes or plans a session-log line in the artifact before the session ends.
Every skill named uses the mbfinotti/advertising-skills@skill-name form and belongs to the collection's 31 skills.
Does not scaffold directories, trackers, or working-tree structure beyond what this first session needs.
